# Bit Manipulation

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_catalog_docs.py; edit catalog.yaml. -->

Using bit operations under precise multiplicity and integer-width assumptions.

This category preserves **4 original syllabus entries**. Each link points to the canonical topic; repeated memberships do not create copied implementations. Topic planning pages record future scope; completed topics have their full lessons and tests.

| --- | --- | --- |
| XOR Tricks for Unique Elements | [xor-unique-elements](xor-unique-elements/README.md) | complete |

Phase 10 covers these four topics in two sequential validated batches. Read [fixed-width contracts](../../docs/bit-conventions.md) for signed values, unsigned operations, multiplicity validation and positional subsets. Actual evidence and approval records are in [Bit checkpoints](../../docs/bit-manipulation-checkpoints.md). Phase 10 was officially owner-approved on 2026-10-24; combined Phases 11 and 12 are authorized. See [the approval checkpoint](../../docs/number-theory-checkpoints.md).
